rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXLVIII Of the Magistery Exercitation or Profession
rules.historical_meaning_only: A new numbered chapter begins lower PDF658 after the honors-duration section.
The author's concept includes serious study and personal delight, not only paid employment.
The source includes skilled art or activity alongside academic learning.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: wherein any one leads his Life
rules.historical_meaning_only: The activity is alleged to occupy a major part of life rather than a transient interest.
Livelihood is named, a different outcome from personal preference or status.
Maintaining reputation is part of the source profession concept.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: spends principall part of his Life
rules.historical_meaning_only: Time allocation is specified, not just formal job title.
Public governance is one category of historical magistery.
Administration of justice is given as a distinct public role.
Military activities are another old professional category.
Hunting is named separately from judicial and martial work.
Philosophy is one study/activity source example.
Theology is another named scholarly profession example.
Mathematics is independently included among practices.
The source explicitly distinguishes private occupations from public offices.
Training/apprenticeship is one path to occupation.
Self-developed skills are an alternative route to profession.
Manual, mechanical and laborious professions also qualify.
A valued activity need not be remunerated to enter author's category.
Lilly broadly asserts near-universal inclination toward some practice, an untested base rate.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: First whether any Trade Study Profession
rules.historical_meaning_only: First declared question is whether a profession exists at all.
The first question explicitly allows no profession as alternative outcome.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Secondly kinds of Art or Study
rules.historical_meaning_only: Second independent question is specific nature/kind of work.
Third question concerns success/prosperity inside chosen activity.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: whether famous therein yea or no
rules.historical_meaning_only: Fame is another outcome, not interchangeable with occupational membership.
An internal source heading begins selection of eligible natal planets.
Mercury, Mars and Venus comprise the three candidate planets in the source.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury shews Wisdome and parts of mind
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mercury is assigned intellectual and mental occupational qualities.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars Strength of body to endure
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mars is assigned bodily stamina/strength as vocational factor.
Venus is assigned delight/pleasure in the work.
A candidate planet in tenth is an eligible profession significator.
First-house placement is another allowed location.
Seventh house is also allowed by Lilly for profession significators.
Essential dignity of candidate is explicitly required/considered in the first branch.
Combustion excludes/weakens candidate in first selection method.
Being under the Sun's beams is another disqualifying condition.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Planet so posited signify Art or Profession
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author concludes the qualifying planet allegedly indicates professional domain.
Several eligible professional planets may coexist rather than one automatically chosen.
An explicit fallback is triggered if no candidate meets first house/dignity criterion.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: any of three Lord Signe of mid heaven
rules.historical_meaning_only: The next method chooses from Mars/Venus/Mercury whichever rules Midheaven sign.
The tenth ruler candidate still needs essential dignity.
Peregrine dignity is stated to prevent this person from being accepted as vocational signifier.
Planet in fall is another explicit disqualification.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if this consideration take not place
rules.historical_meaning_only: If the tenth-ruler alternative fails, source moves to lunar aspect criterion.
Eligible professional planets may be selected through exact lunar aspects.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if two or all three behold her
rules.historical_meaning_only: Multiple candidate aspect situations are anticipated.
Strength ranks multiple Moon-aspecting candidates.
Favorable aspect quality ranks candidates separately.
Closeness of lunar aspect supplies another ordering criterion.
Source gives a traditional orientation precedence not resolved into modern house geometry.
Another lunar-contact test appears after the partile selection instructions.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: aspects Moon within mediety of Orbs
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author permits aspect in half-orb under a further candidate selection branch.
Strong aspect quality is another prerequisite, not mere zodiac contact.
Selected planet must avoid malefic affliction.
Bodily malefic conjunction is a specific disqualifying contact.
A malefic square is another disqualifying contact.
Opposition is a further possible disqualifier.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: If none considerations ... first mover anteceds Sun
rules.historical_meaning_only: Final fallback chooses a planet among three anteceding/rising before Sun.
The source's precise 'first mover' computational meaning is not fully specified in the paragraph.
The last chosen planet receives claimed occupational domain, not proof of actual work.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if none according first or second but third fourth fifth
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly treats fallback-selected professions as less successful than first/second method.
The author applies a stigmatizing old social-class quality judgment.
He additionally speculates reduced industry/competence, not measured performance.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or without any Art at all
rules.historical_meaning_only: Total absence of any profession is a separate allowed endpoint.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: I ever gathered knowledge concerning Trade
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author cites personal retrospective method experience, not a prospective case series.
One author-practice method derives occupation from tenth sign.
The tenth ruler's sign and house are additional author-practice inputs.
The author attributes an alternative selection method to Ptolemy, whose original has not been collated.
Ptolemy's method is explicitly described as two source pathways.
The Sun supplies one pathway, differing from initial Mars/Venus/Mercury eligibility.
Midheaven zodiac sign supplies another pathway.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: planet riseth next before Sun Morning
rules.historical_meaning_only: Specific planet rising immediately before the Sun is one source target.
Tenth ruler is a competing potential vocational signifier.
Planet occupying tenth is alternative to its ruler.
The midheaven route may require an aspect to Moon.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: one Planet doth not only rise before Sun but Lord tenth
rules.historical_meaning_only: Ptolemy-attributed conjunction of morning-riser and tenth-ruler pathways gives highest specificity.
Being at tenth is alternate to ruling tenth within the two-path coincidence.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Master or Significator Actions and Arts
rules.historical_meaning_only: That qualifying shared planet allegedly signifies a person's main activity.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if not both works take him that doth one
rules.historical_meaning_only: If no candidate meets both paths, the author allows a signifier matching only one.
The attributed author is not independent validation of Lilly's method on real people's vocations.
The next separately numbered profession chapter begins mid original PDF660.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Significator of Art single or joined strongly
rules.historical_meaning_only: The first CXLIX condition is navigation only; its substantive mixed-planets taxonomy is not admitted here.
